name: Nui Gwen
creator: frog
description:
The Scissors are coming. This custom skin brings the adorable, yet terrifying, **Nui Harime** to the battlefield as **Gwen**. With her scissor blades in hand, she'll tear through your enemies with a smile, proving that true malice can be wrapped in a cutesy package. Don't be fooled by her cheerful disposition; she's here to slice everything—and everyone—to pieces.
